Inner layer 1, 80 printed, room side, then layer 2
(printed, thinner towards the crown).
Air zone, open between the ribs, for insulation
(dotted).
Cast ribs cut by the plane (crossed hatch): columns
of grid A; each 160 wide across the rib and 240
deep. The cut is longer than 160 and sheared where
the rib is inclined in the face; 4 Ø16 and stirrups
as in the rib section.
Corner blocks: the four hip ribs, cut across the
corners (cast).
Outer layer 80, printed.
Insulation 100 (very thin line), then the outer
layer 30 (dark).

Notes
Large slice at +6.00 (3500 above the eave, just below the
middle horizontal rib of option A), 1:50; small slices at
Option A: all columns at +6.00, every other column after
they pass 500 spacing (+7.00), then only the hip columns
(+8.00). Option B: the diamond lattice keeps the same two
diagonal families at every height, clipped by the hips.
Layer 2 thins towards the crown (the leaf is 160 at the
base, 80 at the crown). Ribs use the same geometry as the
roof-grid sheets; bars and stirrups are assumed.
